wave_classification_reasons: vol_rank_20 (cross-sectional percentile rank of 20-day rolling realized volatility of daily log returns) has never been used as a ranking/classifier feature in any prior MiniQuantDesk experiment (ALPHA-01 used momentum_score, SHORT-01 used slope_60, SHORT-WAVE-02/03 used ret_rank_20/ret_5/gap_pct_1) -- it is a genuinely untested, risk-based mechanism with no definitional overlap with any previously tested return/price-direction feature

the economic rationale (low-volatility / defensive anomaly) is grounded in primary peer-reviewed literature, not retuned from an observed result: Ang, Hodrick, Xing & Zhang (2006), 'The Cross-Section of Volatility and Expected Returns', Journal of Finance 61(1):259-299; Frazzini & Pedersen (2014), 'Betting Against Beta', Journal of Financial Economics 111(1):1-25

the seed universe reused here is the SAME current-registry, non-point-in-time 88-symbol snapshot used by SHORT-WAVE-03 (see docs/research/BROAD_RESEARCH_UNIVERSE_CURRENT_TRUTH_AUDIT.md) -- carrying the identical survivorship-bias caveat forward unchanged, not a fresh point-in-time-clean universe

seed_universe.note: Identical, byte-for-byte reuse of SHORT-WAVE-03's own frozen SEED_UNIVERSE.json (same universe_id) -- not regenerated, not re-derived from a possibly-changed live registry. Frozen BEFORE any DISCOVERY-01 result is observed. NOT historical point-in-time membership -- see docs/research/BROAD_RESEARCH_UNIVERSE_CURRENT_TRUTH_AUDIT.md.

dynamic_cross_section.policy: RANKABLE_SET(T) = seed-universe symbols with a valid OOS ml_score at exact decision timestamp T
dynamic_cross_section.note: Identical policy to SHORT-WAVE-03. A symbol need not have OOS coverage on every historical date.

data.freshness_note: Extends END_UTC well past every prior experiment's 2024-01-01 cutoff (ALPHA-01/SHORT-01/SHORT-WAVE-02/03 all stopped at 2024-01-01). A live, read-only, single-symbol (SPY) Alpaca /v2/stocks/bars check performed during Phase C of the controlling mission (before this predeclaration was frozen, and touching no strategy-outcome data) confirmed bars are actually available through 2026-09-04. The first execution attempt predeclared end_utc=2026-09-05, but the shared mqk_research.data.alpaca_historical pipeline's fail-closed CorporateActionReviewRequired gate refused it: three symbols (CCL, RKLB, XOM) carry unresolved 2025-2026 'name_change' corporate-action events not covered by adjustment='all' semantics. That is a DATA PROVENANCE boundary discovered before any bars were fetched/persisted and before any strategy result was computed -- not a reaction to an economic outcome -- so end_utc was narrowed to strictly before the earliest such event (RKLB, 2025-05-27) rather than patching the shared corporate-action resolver (out of scope for this predeclaration). Most of the resulting development window (2024-01-01..2025-05-01) is therefore still genuinely fresh evidence never used in any prior MiniQuantDesk experiment, and WF_HOLDOUT_MONTHS=6 reserves a genuinely untouched final holdout (~2024-11-01..2025-05-01) never evaluated by this campaign.

cache_safety.policy: Reuse a cache ONLY after fail-closed verification that manifest/content exactly matches: provider, feed, adjustment, asof, requested window, seed universe, corporate-action evidence, canonical semantic bars hash. If exact verification is unavailable, fetch fresh. No existence-only cache reuse (identical policy to SHORT-WAVE-03, reused verbatim in run_wave.py's verify_wave03_bars_cache_authority).

cost_model.note: CONSERVATIVE RESEARCH COST ASSUMPTION, not actual Alpaca commission. Identical to SHORT-WAVE-03/SHORT-WAVE-02.

long_only_rank_weight_rule: top 5 scored names, each desired weight = +0.20
long_short_rank_weight_rule: top 5 LONG each +0.10, bottom 5 SHORT each -0.10; gross=1.0, net=0.0

RISK-01.name: single-feature OOS classifier-score cross-sectional rank, low-volatility (defensive) anomaly predictor
primary_references: Ang, Hodrick, Xing & Zhang (2006), 'The Cross-Section of Volatility and Expected Returns', Journal of Finance 61(1):259-299
Frazzini & Pedersen (2014), 'Betting Against Beta', Journal of Financial Economics 111(1):1-25
RISK-01.economic_rationale: Leverage-constrained investors who cannot use leverage to reach a target return bid up high-beta/high-volatility names for their embedded implicit leverage instead, compressing those names' risk-adjusted (and per BAB, sometimes raw) forward returns relative to low-volatility names. The classifier's OOS score is trained per fold using vol_rank_20 as its sole input feature against the SAME fwd_ret>0 binary label used by every prior single-feature family in this repo; the fold-trained logistic regression learns the empirical sign of the vol/forward-return relationship from training data itself -- no direction is hand-asserted here.
RISK-01.falsification_condition: REJECTED_NOT_ADVANCED if the candidate's risk-adjusted economic performance does not exceed the matched placebo by a non-negligible margin, and/or the candidate materially underperforms the dynamic rankable benchmark, and/or the long-short candidate does not meaningfully outperform its own long-only control.

distinctness_from_prior_mechanisms: vol_rank_20 (a volatility-LEVEL statistic) is definitionally unrelated to ret_rank_20 (20-day cross-sectional momentum), ret_5 (5-day reversal), gap_pct_1 (overnight-gap reversal), slope_60 (trend/regression slope), and momentum_score (a momentum/slope blend) -- all five prior features are return/price-DIRECTION statistics. This is not a retuned parameter variant of any prior family.

benchmark.definition: At each economic decision date, equal-weight the SAME causally rankable symbol set available to this family at that date (RANKABLE_SET(T)) -- no future membership, no holdout. Fold-reset semantics identical to SHORT-WAVE-03's build_fold_reset_benchmark convention.
benchmark.implementation_status: Already implemented and previously exercised by SHORT-WAVE-03's run_01 (benchmark_type=dynamic_equal_weight_causally_rankable_fold_reset_v1); reused verbatim unchanged in this experiment's run_wave.py (build_dynamic_rankable_benchmark), not reimplemented, not invented after seeing returns.

prohibited_after_predeclaration: adaptive rank_side_count/window/universe/horizon retuning based on observed results
mixing placebo trials into the real-candidate experiment id
changing the seed universe after seeing any trial result
inventing or adjusting the benchmark definition after seeing returns
adding RISK-02/RISK-03 variants after seeing this result without a new, separately-reviewed predeclaration
claiming PROVEN_ALPHA or PROMOTION_READY for this development study
consuming the reserved final 6-month holdout in this campaign
